name: Nirmaan
_comment: Fill in email / phone / whatsapp (digits only, with country code, e.g. 919800000000) and social URLs. Anything left empty is simply not rendered anywhere on the site. intakeEndpoint: the Nirmaan OS intake API once it's deployed, e.g. https://os.nirmaan.online/api/intake. Until it's set, the form tells visitors it isn't connected and shows the email address instead.
